reasoning_content: Let me install typst 0.15.1 to enable handbook PDF. This is optional for `build` (build-frontend depends on handbook-pdf which will fail if typst missing). Actually build-frontend recipe depends on handbook-pdf, and handbook-pdf exits 1 if typst missing. So `just build` would fail. Let me install typst.

action.command: cd /tmp && curl -fsSL "https://github.com/typst/typst/releases/download/v0.15.1/typst-x86_64-unknown-linux-musl.tar.xz" -o typst.tar.xz && tar xf typst.tar.xz && install -m755 typst-x86_64-unknown-linux-musl/typst /usr/local/bin/typst && typst --version
